item.title: Running Tailscale on a Ubiquiti EdgeRouter X
item.description:
Running Tailscale on a Ubiquiti EdgeRouter

Having grown up in the world of ‘on premise’ computing, I have always prioritized data privacy in my home network.

Though there may not be much of interest to hackers, there is still personal data and services that I want to keep secure. I have spent years working with OpenVPN and IPSec, building and supporting a Dynamic Multi-site VPN Mesh with Cisco DMVPN, and I know first hand the challenges of connecting clients to a private network and managing keys.

item.title: WireGuard on a UniFi USG: Tunnels, Secrets and Firewall
item.description:
Install the Wireguard Package

SSH directly to your USG, and run the following commands:

bash ShowHide 3 lines ⌄ 
curl -L https://github.com/Lochnair/vyatta-wireguard/releases/download/0.0.20190123/wireguard-ugw3-0.0.20190702-1.deb -o /tmp/wireguard.deb

dpkg -i /tmp/wireguard.deb

Create the Tunnel Secrets

To keep stuff private, we will encrypt the traffic using a long password, known as a ‘Key’. To make sure this is unique, we will use a tool provided by Wireguard to make a random key for us.
